annotations.title: Re-render a video from its storyboard

description: [40 credits] [free: captions_only once per paid render; a missed length target once] A new film from the video's current storyboard, without re-planning, plus any AI visual not yet made (quote_cost prices it). Free once per video when the film missed its length target (length_within_tolerance: false). The file is replaced when the new render finishes. Returns a start receipt; call get_video for the full status.

captions_only.description: true re-times the subtitles on the existing voice track and renders again; nothing is re-recorded, re-scripted or re-voiced. The first resync after a paid render is free, the next costs a render's credits.

draft.description: As create_video; only before the first paid render.

dry_run.description: Quote only; nothing made or charged.

idempotency_key.description: A caller-chosen id for this request. Sending the same key again within 24 hours returns the same re-render instead of starting and charging a second time — use it if your client may retry.

outputs.description: As create_video; must include this video's shape. Other shapes re-render their sibling or make one, a render each.

target_seconds.description: What this film should run now, if it has legitimately grown or shrunk since creation. length_within_tolerance is measured against it and later re-renders keep it; their length fit aims at it (words you wrote are retimed, never rewritten).

theme.description: As create_video; replaces the video's theme and is kept for later re-renders.

name: rerender_video

formats.description: Every shape: video_id, aspect_ratio, status, primary, video_url.
